alt: Three smiling women pose together against a white background, with the woman in the center wearing a vibrant blue textured dress and holding a yellow clutch while pointing at it, flanked by a woman in a striped sweater and another in a black blazer.
A pair of white high-heeled shoes with blue soles and green-accented fabric straps worn by a person standing on a white surface.
A smiling woman poses in a sleeveless blue and green ruffled vest over a white dress, accessorized with a yellow floral headband, a lime green clutch, and white heels.
A woman is seen from behind wearing a sleeveless, textured blue peplum top over a white skirt, paired with white heels featuring blue accents, while holding a yellow clutch.
A smiling woman with dark hair and bright red lipstick wears a vibrant, textured blue dress with colorful accents, a lime green clutch, and a floral headpiece.

A woman with long brown hair is seen from behind, wearing a vibrant blue textured dress with red and yellow accents, a black fascinator hat, and a lime green beaded hair accessory, while holding a matching lime green beaded clutch in her right hand.
A person in a blue patterned dress holds a rectangular clutch purse decorated with lime green and white beads and white piping.
A smiling woman with green eyeliner and a flower in her hair wears a textured blue dress with colorful accents and a chunky green and white necklace.
A smiling woman with green eyelashes holds a lime-green beaded clutch and wears a matching beaded headband and necklace.
A smiling woman stands against a white background wearing a blue ruffled vest over a white skirt, accessorized with a neon yellow headband, clutch, and pearl-adorned white heels.
A close-up of a woman's neck and chest featuring a white, V-shaped pendant necklace adorned with lime green beads, set against a vibrant blue top with colorful, abstract paint-like details.
A smiling woman with bright green eyeliner and red lipstick wears a whimsical white headpiece adorned with lime-green spheres and glitter.
